embedding_config.document_batch_size: at most 32; length buckets with batch * tokens^2 <= 32 * 1024^2 (minimum one)
embedding_config.hybrid: BM25 top-100 + dense top-100; production RRF k=60, equal weights; cap 100; BM25 first for stable ties
embedding_config.note: Offline build excluded. No query, target or score controls indexing. Reuse only exact document text within one repository.

timing_note: Warm components measured separately and summed per issue. BM25 search remeasured during dense preparation. Grep includes successful planning; excludes initial 429 failures and recovery waits. Offline builds excluded; these are not production end-to-end timings.
